Axiom:
`npx gennady sdd-log line|phase|handoff|blocker` is the sole writer for this phase's block under `Execution Log` current Round — phase header, event lines, `ver` lines, `DONE`, Handoff, blocker; append-only, anti-placeholder, timestamped by the tool. A manual `Edit` on that section is out of scope for the phase agent, the tool covers it end to end. Everything else the phase may touch is a direct `Edit`, scoped to: - `Test Scenario Coverage` canonical case names (when test reality differs, phase kind = `test`); - `Phases Overview` Status column for THIS phase ID only.
Anything else (Phases definitions, Rules lists, Target Files, BDD scenarios, Verification table, Dependencies, Meta) → `H_OUT_OF_PHASE_WRITE`. Operator decides via re-planning.
